rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on the northstar_enterprise.enterprise_federation_mapping and enterprise_provisioning_record tables, then drops both tables and the northstar_enterprise schema (CASCADE); on a shared environment restore from the pre-migration backup instead. The schema holds only enterprise federation-mapping linkage records and SCIM provisioning-record metadata (the subjects/sessions themselves live in the identity schema and are untouched), so a rollback affects no other module's data.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_enterprise schema with the enterprise_federation_mapping and enterprise_provisioning_record tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every tenant-scoped enterprise table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC
